montana.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website theme-catalog card background
Primary request: Photorealistic editorial documentary landscape photograph of an honest mountain campsite in inland Spain at a crisp early-autumn morning.
Scene/backdrop: A modest timber-and-stone service lodge and two well-spaced camping pitches among Scots pines and broadleaf trees, with a low forested ridge behind and a trace of cool mist between the trunks.
Subject: Durable gravel paths, practical rain protection and lived-in natural materials that suggest a long season.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, tactile real-world texture, subtle 35mm grain.
Composition/framing: Wide 3:2 landscape composition with layered depth; designed to remain legible beneath a restrained website-interface overlay.
Lighting/mood: Crisp cool morning light, quiet and sheltered.
Color palette: Restrained moss, slate, bark and muted ochre.
Constraints: Plausible Spanish mountain campsite; no dramatic alpine peaks; no snow; no luxury glamping; no people; no text; no signage; no logos; no readable number plates; no HDR; no watermark; no impossible architecture.
